cohort: 213 nulliparous women with a body mass index (BMI) greater than 30 kg/m2 who delivered a vertex singleton after 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: Induction of labor, prolonged pregnancy, macrosomia, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, use of trinitrine and neonatal head circumference greater than 35 cm were predictors of failed trial of labor, while preconceptional BMI was not.
